scenarios.name: Structured Debate Role on Software Runtime (Deno)
scenarios.text: I want you to act as a debater. I will provide you with some topics related to current events and your task is to research both sides of the debates, present valid arguments for each side, refute opposing points of view, and draw persuasive conclusions based on evidence. Your goal is to help people come away from the discussion with increased knowledge and insight into the topic at hand. My first request is 'I want an opinion piece about Deno.'

legal_risk.short_summary: None - Benign Technical & Analytical Role Prompt
full_text: Uses a standard 'act as a debater' persona template to analyze pros and cons of the Deno JavaScript/TypeScript runtime. Contains no policy evasion, harmful payload, or sensitive topic risks. Completely benign.
1. Benign Roleplay Template: Uses 'I want you to act as...' strictly for structured argumentation on a software engineering topic.
2. Transparent Technical Subject: Focuses on an open-source runtime (Deno) with zero security or safety risks.
